content:
# ============================================================
#  NewGen Team - Language: English (en_US)
#  Syntax: MiniMessage (https://docs.advntr.dev/minimessage/format.html)
#  Theme tokens: <primary> <secondary> <accent> <muted>
#                <danger> <success> <warning> <info>
#  Token colors are configured in theme.yml - change once, restyle everything.
#  This file is the FALLBACK: any key missing in another language
#  resolves here, so it must always contain every key.
#  Do NOT use the § character or legacy & color codes.
# ============================================================
prefix: "<secondary><bold>NewGen Team</bold> <dark_gray>»</dark_gray> <accent>"

general:
  no-permission: "<secondary>You don't have permission to do that."
  player-not-found: "<secondary>That player could not be found."
  error: "<secondary>An error occurred. Please try again."
  reloaded: "<primary>Configuration reloaded successfully."

team:
  created: "<primary>Team <accent>%name%<primary> created! Use <accent>/team <primary>to manage it."
  create-hint: "<accent>Open the main menu with <secondary>/team <accent>and pick \"Create Team\" to get started."
  disbanded: "<primary>Your team has been disbanded."
  renamed: "<primary>Team renamed to <accent>%name%<primary>."
  left: "<primary>You left the team."
  already-in: "<secondary>You are already in a team."
  not-in: "<secondary>You are not in a team."
  name-taken: "<secondary>That team name is already taken."
  name-invalid: "<secondary>Invalid name. Use 3-16 characters (letters, numbers, spaces and common symbols)."
  leader-must-transfer: "<secondary>You are the team owner. Transfer ownership or disband first."
  list-header: "<secondary><bold>Team List</bold> <accent>(<primary>%count%<accent>):"
  list-entry: "<accent>- <primary>%name% <accent>[<primary>%tag%<accent>] <dark_gray>(%members% members)"

member:
  kicked: "<primary>Kicked <accent>%player% <primary>from the team."
  role-set: "<primary>Set <accent>%player%<primary>'s role to <accent>%role%<primary>."
  transferred: "<primary>Transferred team ownership to <accent>%player%<primary>."
  cannot-target-self: "<secondary>You cannot target yourself."

invite:
  sent: "<primary>Invitation sent to <accent>%player%<primary>."
  received: "<primary>You were invited to team <accent>%team%<primary>. Open <accent>/team <primary>to accept."
  accepted: "<primary>You joined team <accent>%team%<primary>!"
  denied: "<accent>Invitation declined."
  expired: "<secondary>That invitation has expired."
  none: "<secondary>You have no pending invitations."
  specify: "<secondary>You have multiple invitations. Pick a team in the Invites menu."
  team-full: "<secondary>That team is full."
  already-in-team: "<secondary>That player is already in another team."

join:
  requested: "<primary>Join request sent to team <accent>%team%<primary>. Wait for approval!"
  already-requested: "<secondary>You already requested to join this team."
  accepted: "<primary>Accepted <accent>%player%<primary> into the team."
  declined: "<accent>Declined <primary>%player%<accent>'s request."
  you-accepted: "<primary>You were accepted into team <accent>%team%<primary>!"
  officer-notify: "<accent>[<secondary>Team<accent>] <primary>%player% <accent>requested to join. Open the menu to review."

chest:
  no-access: "<secondary>You don't have permission to open the team chest."

bank:
  prompt-deposit: "<primary>Enter the amount to deposit into the team bank <accent>(type 'cancel' to abort)<primary>."
  prompt-withdraw: "<primary>Enter the amount to withdraw from the team bank <accent>(type 'cancel' to abort)<primary>."
  deposit-success: "<primary>Deposited <accent>$%amount% <primary>into the team bank. Balance: <accent>$%balance%<primary>."
  withdraw-success: "<primary>Withdrew <accent>$%amount% <primary>from the team bank. Balance: <accent>$%balance%<primary>."
  invalid-amount: "<secondary>Invalid amount. Enter a positive number."
  not-enough-personal: "<secondary>You don't have enough money to deposit."
  not-enough-team: "<secondary>The team bank doesn't have enough balance."
  no-economy: "<secondary>Vault Economy is not installed - the bank feature is disabled."

upgrade:
  success: "<primary>Team upgraded to <accent>level %level%<primary>! All perks unlocked."
  max-level: "<accent>The team is already at max level."
  no-economy: "<secondary>PlayerPoints is not installed - the upgrade feature is disabled."
  insufficient: "<secondary>You don't have enough points to upgrade."

home:
  set: "<primary>Team home set at your current location."
  named-set: "<primary>Home <accent>%name%<primary> set at your location."
  named-deleted: "<accent>Deleted home <primary>%name%<accent>."
  limit-reached: "<secondary>Your team reached its home limit. Upgrade to add more."
  name-taken: "<secondary>A home with that name already exists."
  name-invalid: "<secondary>Invalid home name (max 24 characters)."
  prompt-name: "<primary>Enter a name for the new home on the sign <accent>(type 'cancel' to abort)<primary>."
  teleported: "<primary>Teleported to the team home."
  warmup: "<accent>Teleporting in <primary>%seconds%s<accent>. Don't move."
  cancelled: "<secondary>Teleport cancelled."
  cooldown: "<secondary>You must wait <accent>%seconds%s <secondary>before teleporting again."
  none: "<secondary>Your team has no home set."
  world-missing: "<secondary>The world containing the team home is not loaded."

chat:
  enabled: "<primary>Team chat enabled. Your messages will go to teammates."
  disabled: "<accent>Team chat disabled."

relation:
  ally-set: "<primary>You are now allied with team <accent>%team%<primary>."
  ally-accepted: "<primary>Accepted the alliance with team <accent>%team%<primary>."
  ally-requested: "<primary>Alliance request sent to team <accent>%team%<primary>."
  ally-cancelled: "<primary>Cancelled the alliance request with team <accent>%team%<primary>."
  enemy-set: "<secondary>You marked team <accent>%team% <secondary>as an enemy."
  requests-disabled: "<secondary>That team is not accepting alliance requests."
  already-ally: "<secondary>That team is already your ally."
  not-ally: "<secondary>That team is not your ally."

notify:
  member-online: "<accent>[<secondary>Team<accent>] <primary>%player% <accent>is now online."
  member-offline: "<accent>[<secondary>Team<accent>] <primary>%player% <accent>went offline."
  disbanded: "<accent>[<secondary>Team<accent>] <primary>%player% <accent>disbanded the team."
  renamed: "<accent>[<secondary>Team<accent>] <primary>%player% <accent>renamed the team to <accent>%name%<accent>."
  invited: "<accent>[<secondary>Team<accent>] <primary>%player% <accent>invited <primary>%target% <accent>to the team."
  joined: "<accent>[<secondary>Team<accent>] <primary>%player% <accent>joined the team."
  left: "<accent>[<secondary>Team<accent>] <primary>%player% <accent>left the team."
  kicked: "<accent>[<secondary>Team<accent>] <primary>%player% <accent>kicked <primary>%target% <accent>from the team."
  role-set: "<accent>[<secondary>Team<accent>] <primary>%player% <accent>set <primary>%target%<accent>'s role to %role%<accent>."
  transferred: "<accent>[<secondary>Team<accent>] <primary>%player% <accent>transferred ownership to <primary>%target%<accent>."

search:
  prompt: "<primary>Type a player or team name in chat <accent>(type 'cancel' to abort)<primary>."
  cancelled: "<accent>Search cancelled."
  no-results: "<secondary>No results found for <accent>%query%<secondary>."
  searching: "<accent>Searching for <primary>%query%<accent>..."

permission:
  title: "<secondary><bold>Permissions</bold>"
  title-team: "<secondary><bold>%team% <dark_gray>-</dark_gray> Permissions</bold>"
  weight: "<muted>Rank weight: <accent>%weight%"
  header: "<muted>Permissions:"
  all: "<primary>✔ Full access"
  has: "<primary>✔ "
  missing: "<muted>✖ "
  # Display labels per permission. Keys must match TeamPermission constants.
  names:
    INVITE_MEMBER: "Invite members"
    KICK_MEMBER: "Kick members"
    MANAGE_ROLES: "Manage roles"
    REVIEW_INVITES: "Review invites"
    REVIEW_JOIN_REQUESTS: "Review join requests"
    RENAME_TEAM: "Rename team"
    EDIT_SETTINGS: "Edit team settings"
    DISBAND_TEAM: "Disband team"
    TRANSFER_LEADER: "Transfer ownership"
    CHEST_OPEN: "Open team chest"
    CHEST_DEPOSIT: "Deposit into chest"
    CHEST_WITHDRAW: "Withdraw from chest"
    CHEST_UPGRADE: "Upgrade chest"
    SET_HOME: "Set team home"
    TELEPORT_HOME: "Teleport to home"
    DELETE_HOME: "Delete team home"
    MANAGE_RELATIONS: "Manage allies/enemies"
    TOGGLE_TEAM_CHAT: "Toggle team chat"
    MANAGE_MEMBERS: "Manage members"
    WITHDRAW_BALANCE: "Withdraw team money"

admin:
  no-permission: "<secondary>You don't have permission to use the admin panel."
  team-missing: "<secondary>That team no longer exists."
  invalid-number: "<secondary>Invalid number. Enter an integer."
  search-player-prompt: "<primary>Enter a player name to open their team <accent>(type 'cancel' to abort)<primary>."
  player-no-team: "<secondary>Player <accent>%player% <secondary>is not in any team."
  rename-prompt: "<primary>Enter the new team name <accent>(type 'cancel' to abort)<primary>."
  tag-prompt: "<primary>Enter the new team tag <accent>(type 'cancel' to abort)<primary>."
  bank-prompt: "<primary>Enter an amount <accent>(type 'cancel' to abort)<primary>."
  add-member-prompt: "<primary>Enter the player name to add <accent>(type 'cancel' to abort)<primary>."

command:
  create-usage: "<secondary>Usage: /team create <name> [tag]"
  rename-usage: "<secondary>Usage: /team rename <new name>"
  invite-usage: "<secondary>Usage: /team invite <player>"
  kick-usage: "<secondary>Usage: /team kick <player>"
  help: |-
    <secondary><bold>█ NewGen Team Help</bold> <accent>────────────
    <accent>/team <muted>- Open the team menu
    <accent>/team create <name> [tag] <muted>- Create a new team
    <accent>/team invite <player> <muted>- Invite a player
    <accent>/team accept|deny <muted>- Respond to an invite
    <accent>/team kick <player> <muted>- Kick a member
    <accent>/team leave <muted>- Leave your team
    <accent>/team home <muted>- Open the homes menu
    <accent>/team sethome <muted>- Set the team home
    <accent>/team chat [message] <muted>- Toggle/send team chat
    <accent>/team top <muted>- View the leaderboard
    <accent>/team info <muted>- View team info
    <accent>/team list <muted>- List all teams
    <accent>/team admin <muted>- Open the admin panel (staff)

# ============================================================
#  GUI - All text displayed inside menus.
#  Placeholders: %team% %player% %leader% %members% %limit% %tier%
#                %balance% %level% %slots% %pages% %used% %date%
#                %query% %price% %currency% %status% %count%
# ============================================================
gui:
  # ---- Shared buttons (Icons) ----
  common:
    back: "<secondary>← Back"
    close: "<secondary>✖ Close"
    close-lore: "<muted>Close this panel"
    confirm: "<success>✔ Confirm"
    cancel: "<danger>✖ Cancel"
    cancel-lore: "<muted>Cancel and go back"
    back-lore: "<muted>Return to the previous menu"
    next-page: "<secondary>Next page →"
    next-page-lore: "<muted>Go to page <accent>%page%"
    prev-page: "<secondary>← Previous page"
    prev-page-lore: "<muted>Go to page <accent>%page%"
    click-open: "<primary>Click to open"
    click-manage: "<primary>Click to manage"
    click-view: "<primary>Click to view"
    click-toggle: "<primary>Click to toggle"
    click-set: "<primary>Click to set"
    click-edit: "<primary>Click to edit"
    click-select: "<primary>Click to select"
    type-name: "<primary>Click, then type a name"
    type-amount: "<primary>Click, then enter an amount"
    view-only: "<muted>View only (missing edit permission)"
    irreversible: "<danger>This cannot be undone!"
    no-team: "<muted>Not in any team"
    members: "<muted>Members: <accent>%members%"
    members-limit: "<muted>Members: <accent>%members%<muted>/<accent>%limit%"
    team-tier: "<muted>Team level: <accent>%tier%"
    team-balance: "<muted>Balance: <accent>$%balance%"
    chest-level: "<muted>Chest level: <accent>%level%"
    leader: "<muted>Leader: <accent>%leader%"
    created: "<muted>Founded: <accent>%date%"

  # ---- Main menu ----
  main:
    title: "<secondary><bold>NewGen Team</bold>"
    team-header: "<secondary><bold>%team%</bold> <accent>[<secondary>%tag%<accent>]"
    create: "<secondary><bold>Create Team</bold>"
    create-lore1: "<muted>You are not in a team yet."
    create-lore2: "<primary>Click to create a new team"
    my-invites: "<secondary><bold>Your Invitations</bold>"
    browse-teams: "<secondary><bold>Team List</bold>"
    browse-teams-lore: "<muted>Browse & search every team on the server"
    leaderboard: "<secondary><bold>Leaderboard</bold>"
    leaderboard-lore: "<muted>Server leaderboard (KDR)"
    members: "<secondary><bold>Members</bold>"
    members-lore: "<muted>Manage your team members"
    invites: "<secondary><bold>Invitations</bold>"
    invites-lore: "<muted>Invite players & review requests"
    permissions-lore: "<muted>Customize permissions per role"
    chest: "<secondary><bold>Team Chest</bold>"
    bank: "<secondary><bold>Team Bank</bold>"
    bank-lore: "<muted>Anyone can deposit, mod+ can withdraw."
    upgrade: "<secondary><bold>Team Level</bold>"
    upgrade-lore: "<muted>Upgrade your team's perk package"
    homes-lore: "<muted>Set & teleport to team homes"
    settings: "<secondary><bold>Settings</bold>"
    settings-lore: "<muted>Toggle team options"
    stats: "<secondary><bold>Statistics</bold>"
    stats-lore: "<muted>View detailed team statistics"
    leave: "<danger><bold>Leave Team</bold>"
    leave-lore: "<muted>Leave <accent>%team%"
    leave-confirm-title: "<danger>Leave Team?"
    team-chat-lore: "<muted>Toggle private team chat mode"
    invite-players-lore: "<muted>Invite players without a team."
    relations-lore: "<muted>Manage diplomatic relations"
    create-lore-desc1: "<muted>Create a brand new team of your own,"
    create-lore-desc2: "<muted>or find another team to join."
    my-invites-lore1: "<muted>See which teams invited you,"
    my-invites-lore2: "<muted>accept or decline right away."
    players: "<secondary><bold>Players</bold>"
    players-lore: "<muted>Browse & search all players."
    browse-teams-join-lore: "<muted>Browse & find a team to join."
    leaderboard-simple-lore: "<muted>View the server's top teams"
    permissions: "<secondary><bold>Permissions</bold>"
    homes: "<secondary><bold>Team Homes</bold>"
    relations: "<secondary><bold>Allies / Enemies</bold>"
    chest-lore: "<muted>Shared storage — level <accent>%level%"
    your-role: "<muted>Your role: %role%"
    kd: "<muted>K/D: <accent>%kills%<muted>/<accent>%deaths% <dark_gray>(%kdr%)"
    disband: "<danger><bold>Disband Team</bold>"
    disband-lore: "<muted>Permanently delete this team"
    disband-confirm-title: "<danger>Disband Team?"
    disband-confirm-lore: "<muted>Permanently delete <accent>%team%"
    chat-toggle: "<secondary><bold>Team Chat: %status%</bold>"
    chat-on: "<success>ON"
    chat-off: "<muted>OFF"
    join-requests: "<secondary><bold>Join Requests</bold>"
    join-requests-lore: "<muted>Review players requesting to join."
    join-requests-pending: "<muted>Pending: <accent>%count%"

  # ---- Bank ----
  bank:
    title: "<secondary><bold>Team Bank</bold>"
    title-team: "<secondary><bold>%team% — Bank</bold>"
    team-balance: "<muted>Team balance: <accent>$%balance%"
    your-balance: "<secondary><bold>Your Balance</bold>"
    personal-wallet: "<muted>Personal wallet: <accent>$%balance%"
    deposit: "<secondary><bold>↓ Deposit</bold>"
    deposit-lore1: "<muted>Move $ from your wallet into the team bank."
    deposit-lore2: "<muted>Every member can deposit."
    withdraw: "<secondary><bold>↑ Withdraw</bold>"
    withdraw-lore1: "<muted>Move $ from the team bank to your wallet."
    withdraw-lore2: "<muted>Moderator or higher only."
    withdraw-locked: "<muted><bold>↑ Withdraw (LOCKED)</bold>"
    withdraw-locked-lore: "<danger>Requires Moderator rank or higher."
    amount-hint: "<primary>Click to enter an amount"
    no-withdraw: "<muted>You don't have permission to withdraw."

  # ---- Create team ----
  create:
    title: "<secondary><bold>Create New Team</bold>"
    name-header: "<muted>Name your team:"
    name-length: "<muted>• 3-%max% characters long"
    name-allowed: "<muted>• Letters, numbers, spaces & common symbols allowed"
    sign-hint: "<primary>Click, then type a name on the sign"

  # ---- Team homes ----
  home:
    title: "<secondary><bold>Team Homes</bold>"
    title-team: "<secondary><bold>%team% — Homes</bold>"
    entry-name: "<secondary><bold>%name%</bold>"
    world-line: "<muted>World: <accent>%world%"
    coords-line: "<muted>X: <accent>%x% <muted>Y: <accent>%y% <muted>Z: <accent>%z%"
    left-teleport: "<secondary>Left-click: <muted>Teleport"
    right-delete: "<danger>Right-click: <muted>Delete home"
    add-new: "<secondary><bold>Add New Home</bold>"
    count: "<muted>Homes: <accent>%used%<muted>/<accent>%limit%"
    set-hint: "<muted>Click to name & set a home"

  # ---- Invites ----
  invite:
    title: "<secondary><bold>Invite Players</bold>"
    title-team: "<secondary><bold>%team% <dark_gray>-</dark_gray> Invite Players</bold>"
    entry-name: "<accent>%player%"
  my-invites:
    title: "<secondary><bold>Your Invitations</bold>"
    left-accept: "<secondary>Left-click: <muted>Accept"
    right-decline: "<danger>Right-click: <muted>Decline"
    empty: "<danger>No invitations"
    empty-lore: "<muted>No team has invited you yet."
    empty-hint: "<muted>Find a team and request to join!"
  join-request:
    title: "<secondary><bold>Join Requests</bold>"
    title-team: "<secondary><bold>%team% — Requests</bold>"
    entry-name: "<secondary>%player% %status%"
    status-online: "<success>●"
    status-offline: "<muted>○"
    wants-join: "<muted>Wants to join your team."
    left-accept: "<secondary>Left-click: <muted>Accept"
    right-decline: "<danger>Right-click: <muted>Decline"
    empty: "<danger>No requests yet"
    empty-lore1: "<muted>When someone requests to join,"
    empty-lore2: "<muted>they will appear here for review."

  # ---- Members / roles ----
  member:
    title: "<secondary><bold>Team Members</bold>"
    title-team: "<secondary><bold>%team% — Members</bold>"
    left-click: "<secondary>Left-click: <muted>Manage role"
    entry-name: "<secondary>%player% %status%"
    status-online: "<success>●"
    status-offline: "<muted>○"
    role-line: "<muted>Role: %role%"
    shift-kick: "<danger>Shift-click: <muted>Kick from the team"
    kick-confirm-title: "<danger>Kick member?"
    kick-confirm-lore: "<muted>Kick <accent>%player%"
  role:
    title: "<secondary><bold>Assign Role</bold>"
    target-name: "<secondary>%player%"
    current-role: "<muted>Current role: %role%"
    transfer-target: "<muted>Make <accent>%player% <muted>the new team owner"
    transfer-confirm-title: "<danger>Transfer ownership?"
    transfer-confirm-lore: "<muted>Make <accent>%player% <muted>the team owner"
    names:
      OWNER: "<secondary><bold>Team Owner</bold>"
      CO_OWNER: "<secondary>Co-Owner"
      ADMIN: "<accent>Admin"
      MOD: "<accent>Moderator"
      MEMBER: "<muted>Member"
      RECRUIT: "<muted>Recruit"
    assign-hint: "<primary>Click to assign this role"
    assign-denied: "<muted>You cannot assign this role"
    transfer: "<danger><bold>Transfer Ownership</bold>"
    transfer-lore: "<danger>You will become Co-Owner."

  # ---- Player / team lists ----
  player-list:
    title: "<secondary><bold>Players</bold>"
    title-query: "<secondary><bold>Players: <accent>%query%</bold>"
    entry-name: "<secondary>%player% %status%"
    status-online: "<success>●"
    status-offline: "<muted>○"
    team-line: "<muted>Team: <accent>%team%"
    status-line: "<muted>Status: %status%"
    state-online: "<success>Online"
    state-offline: "<muted>Offline"
    invite-hint: "<primary>Click to invite to your team"
    view-hint: "<primary>Click to view their team"
    search: "<secondary><bold>Search</bold>"
    search-lore: "<muted>Type a player name to filter the list."
    showing-all: "<muted>Showing: <accent>all players"
    filtering: "<muted>Filtering: <accent>%query%"
    clear-filter: "<danger><bold>Clear Filter</bold>"
    clear-filter-lore: "<muted>Show every player again."
  team-list:
    title: "<secondary><bold>Team List</bold>"
    title-query: "<secondary><bold>Teams: <accent>%query%</bold>"
    kdr-line: "<muted>KDR: <accent>%kdr%"
    join-hint: "<primary>Click to request to join"
    view-hint: "<primary>Click to view details"
    search-lore: "<muted>Type a team name or tag to filter."
    showing-all: "<muted>Showing: <accent>all teams"
    filtering: "<muted>Filtering: <accent>%query%"
    clear-filter: "<danger><bold>Clear Filter</bold>"
    clear-filter-lore: "<muted>Show every team again."
    empty: "<danger>No teams found"
    empty-lore: "<muted>Try another keyword or create a new team!"
  team-detail:
    title: "<secondary><bold>Team Info</bold>"
    missing: "<danger>This team no longer exists"
    missing-lore: "<muted>It may have been disbanded."
    kills: "<secondary><bold>Kills</bold>"
    deaths: "<secondary><bold>Deaths</bold>"
    kdr: "<secondary><bold>KDR</bold>"
    value: "<accent>%value%"
    chest-slots-line: "<muted>Slots <accent>%slots%"
    balance: "<secondary><bold>Balance</bold>"
    member-name: "<secondary>%player% %status%"
    status-online: "<success>●"
    status-offline: "<muted>○"
    member-role-line: "<muted>Role: %role%"
    request-join: "<secondary><bold>Request To Join</bold>"
    request-join-lore1: "<muted>Send a join request to this team."
    request-join-lore2: "<muted>A team manager will review it."
    request-join-hint: "<primary>Click to request to join"

  # ---- Allies / Enemies ----
  ally:
    title: "<secondary><bold>Allies / Enemies</bold>"
    title-team: "<secondary><bold>%team% <dark_gray>-</dark_gray> Relations</bold>"
    no-team: "<danger>No team"
    entry-name: "<secondary><bold>%team%</bold> <muted>[<accent>%tag%<muted>]"
    relation-line: "<muted>Relation: %relation%"
    state-ally: "<success>Ally"
    state-enemy: "<danger>Enemy"
    state-pending: "<warning>Pending request"
    state-sent: "<warning>Request sent"
    state-neutral: "<muted>Neutral"
    left-remove-ally: "<warning>Left-click <muted>to remove ally"
    right-mark-enemy: "<danger>Right-click <muted>to mark as enemy"
    right-remove-enemy: "<danger>Right-click <muted>to remove enemy"
    left-accept: "<warning>Left-click <muted>to accept the ally request"
    waiting: "<muted>Waiting for a response..."
    left-cancel: "<warning>Left-click <muted>to cancel the request"
    left-request: "<warning>Left-click <muted>to request an alliance"

  # ---- Search ----
  search:
    title: "<secondary><bold>Search</bold>"
    find-player: "<secondary><bold>Find Player</bold>"
    find-player-lore: "<muted>Type a player name to view"
    find-team: "<secondary><bold>Find Team</bold>"
    find-team-lore: "<muted>Type a team name or tag to view"
    all-players: "<secondary><bold>Browse All Players</bold>"
    all-players-lore1: "<muted>Browse every player who has ever"
    all-players-lore2: "<muted>joined the server, one head per slot."
    all-teams: "<secondary><bold>Browse All Teams</bold>"
    all-teams-lore1: "<muted>Browse every team that exists"
    all-teams-lore2: "<muted>on the server, one slot per team."
    type-in-chat: "<primary>Click, then type a name in chat"
    open-list-hint: "<primary>Click to open the list"
  search-result:
    title-players: "<secondary><bold>Players: <accent>%query%</bold>"
